hint_events_level.name: hint_events_level
hint_events_level.value: ("hint_events"."kind" = 'solution' AND "hint_events"."level" IS NULL) OR ("hint_events"."kind" <> 'solution' AND "hint_events"."level" BETWEEN 1 AND 3)

misconception_observations_ai.name: misconception_observations_ai
misconception_observations_ai.value: "misconception_observations"."misconception_id" NOT LIKE 'ai.%' OR ("misconception_observations"."source" = 'ai' AND "misconception_observations"."ai_description" IS NOT NULL)

pending_ratings_flush.name: pending_ratings_flush
pending_ratings_flush.value: ("pending_ratings"."flushed_at" IS NULL AND "pending_ratings"."flush_outcome" IS NULL) OR ("pending_ratings"."flushed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "pending_ratings"."flush_outcome" IN ('applied', 'skipped'))
